'''Micja Corneli''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Friends of Slungerhounds]]. A [[slungerhound]] owner, Corneli was angry that the creatures were banned on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] after a high amount of attacks against [[Human/Legends|Humans]].
